initial: Create an exceptionally polished visual art-direction book / presentation board for AttestNode, a native Mac peer-to-peer research app. This is CONCEPT ART, not an implemented screenshot. Wide landscape board, editorial-quality typography with legible short labels, generous purposeful hierarchy, design-agency craft. Show a coherent distinctive system with a large main app screen and three smaller supporting screen studies, typography specimen, 5 palette swatches, and a three-frame motion strip. Preserve the approved simple user journey: automatic app verification and peer connection; receipt then artwork reveal; optional independent Apple developer signing handoff. The NFT is Fold, a beautiful sculptural orb of six twisting ivory porcelain ribbons with vermilion glazed inner surfaces, soft beveled edges, a hollow central aperture. It is the central object, not a generic coin or wallet. No finance dashboards, token prices, spaceship UI, stock icons, lorem ipsum, pointless metric cards or generic SaaS page. Native app chrome very restrained. Use short exact screen labels 'Connecting', 'Your Fold', 'Independent builder', 'Approve handoff'. Include 'ATTESTNODE' and 'DESIGN STUDY' as small editorial labels. Main screen should feel like a desirable tactile instrument one wants to leave running. DIRECTION 01: KILN. Title 'KILN / 01'. Push far beyond tasteful beige gallery layout: vermilion architectural color planes, off-white ceramic surfaces, deep oxblood accents, extreme scale contrast, boldly cropped sculpture intersecting layout zones without obscuring controls, high-contrast elegant serif title with precise humanist sans controls. Main connected screen shows the porcelain sculpture nearly filling the app, sharp red side rail and oversized 002 engraving-like numerals. Physical grazing light and delicate ceramic microtexture, stark beautiful asymmetric composition. Supporting screens: glowing warm seam while connecting, Fold emerging from a red plane on receipt confirmation, beautiful sober consent sheet with pair of matching key-fingerprint samples. Motion strip illustrates 'Gather / Form / Settle' with 3 sculpture states. Bottom typography specimen 'Aa / Your place here.' Keep a few clear actual usable buttons rather than abstract poster-only design. Cream, vermilion, oxblood, porcelain, graphite. Flat orthographic board, no photographed book mockup, no desk.
